What Is Sentiment Analysis? A Comprehensive Guide
Sentiment analysis (also known as opinion mining) refers to identifying emotions expressed by people on social media platforms like Twitter , Facebook etc., based upon their posts/comments/reviews/feedbacks regarding products/services/events/people/etc.. It helps businesses understand consumer behavior better so they could make informed decisions accordingly while improving overall user experience & satisfaction levels across multiple touchpoints throughout entire lifecycle stages starting with acquisition till retention phase..
How Does This Work Exactly?
There are two main types - supervised learning where we train models using labeled datasets containing positive/negative reviews alongside other features related e.g product name; unsupervised approach wherein no prior knowledge required but requires large amount of unlabeled data set available publicly online via web scraping techniques . Both methods have pros cons depending application scenario requirements .
In conclusion : If you want your business grow exponentially then start investing time effort into building robust system capable detecting sentiments accurately efficiently !
